snippet.title: Geamana Village | Deep and Atmospheric Game Based On Real Tragic Events
snippet.description:
Geamana Village | Deep and Atmospheric Game Based On Real Tragic Events
#newgame #gameplay #gaming #indiegame #horrorgaming #atmospheric 

Buy Game -https://store.steampowered.com/app/3815000/Geamana_Village/

“Through its structure and presentation, Geamana Village positions itself as a peaceful yet unsettling experience, focused on memory, silence, and the irreversible consequences of industrial pollution.”
First Play

“The game offers a deep and atmospheric experience based on real tragic events.”
Start-up

“A haunting tribute to a lost place. Geamana Village invites you to wander, remember, and feel the weight of what once was.”
Need4Games

About This Game
Geamana Village is a slow-paced, atmospheric investigative experience that invites you to explore a devastated place. As you make your way through the last isolated homes spared by the flood, you’ll speak with the few remaining locals, examine abandoned belongings, and uncover fragments of a life once lived. In the distance, the remnants of the village church still stand, silent, damaged, and waiting to be discovered.

Core Features
Investigative Photography

Capture the ruins, the toxic lake, and haunting traces of the disaster. Each photo serves as both evidence and memory, revealing details overlooked by the eye.


Interview Locals

Speak with the last remaining locals. Their trust must be earned and their stories often conflict, leaving you to decide what to believe.


Search for Clues

Find letters, reports, personal notes, and official documents scattered across the village. Every page is a missing piece of the puzzle.


Earn Trust, Unlock Stories

Help locals with small tasks. Only those who trust you will share their deepest memories.


Explore at Your Own Pace

Walk at your own rhythm through a quiet, haunting space shaped by memory, silence, and irreversible damage.


Story
A story buried under poison and silence.

In 1977, during communist rule, mining operations poisoned an entire valley. Toxic water was released without warning, swallowing homes overnight. Families fled or vanished, and a once-thriving village was drowned beneath a lake of waste.

Twenty years later, Moloce Arcip, a former journalist desperate for redemption, hears a radio report about a forgotten village, and sees one last chance to rebuild his career and uncover a story the world tried to erase.

Armed only with your camera and a notebook, you set out to document the traces of what remains. Silence rules the empty streets. A few locals remain, clinging to their homes despite the danger. The spire of the church still juts from the toxic lake, a lonely monument to everything that was lost.

Inspired by true events. Step into a story buried for 20 years.

00:00 Start
